definition: Infrastructure as code describes and provisions infrastructure from versioned definitions.
A stack is a collection of AWS resources managed together from a CloudFormation template.
A construct is a reusable code component that defines cloud infrastructure.
A module packages reusable resource configurations for inclusion in CloudFormation templates.
A portfolio groups Service Catalog products and controls which users may access them.
An association connects a desired configuration with its targets and execution schedule.
Desired state is the configuration that managed nodes or resources are expected to maintain.
A feature flag is an application setting that controls whether behavior is enabled.
Remediation performs actions to repair a resource that violates a configuration rule.
A runbook defines actions that Systems Manager Automation performs.
Drift is a difference between actual resource settings and their expected template settings.
A change set previews the effects of proposed CloudFormation stack changes before execution.
SecureString is a Parameter Store value encrypted using AWS KMS.
Rotation updates a secret and the credentials in the system that uses it.
